info.title: StaffAny API Reference (BETA)
info.description: BETA reference for StaffAny external API endpoints. Workspace (v1) contains the original /workspace/v1 endpoints with legacy response shapes. Domain groups marked (v2) contain the newer /workspace/v2 endpoints, grouped by business capability with more consistent response shapes. Authenticate with a Bearer token and expect successful responses in a top-level data envelope.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token used to authenticate StaffAny API requests. Format: wks_<prefix>.<secret>.

get.summary: List the authenticated user's group memberships
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's section, team, and role memberships. Does not return full group member rosters.

data.description: Caller-owned group memberships across sections, teams, and roles

orgUserDetailId.description: Org user detail ID when available

get.summary: Retrieve the authenticated user and organisation context
get.description: Returns the authenticated user profile, current organisation, access level, and resolved permissions.

name.description: Full name from organisation user detail

organisation.description: Organisation resolved from the authenticated token

get.description: Returns roles in the authenticated organisation context. Use roleDetails.id as roles[].roleId when calling POST /workspace/v1/shifts/bulk-create.

data.description: Role rows in the authenticated organisation context

get.description: Returns sales rows for sections visible to the authenticated user. When provided, sectionIds must be a strict subset of the caller-visible section IDs.

totalTargetSales.description: Sum of target sales for the range

get.description: Returns active sections in the authenticated organisation context.

data.description: Section rows in the authenticated organisation context

get.description: Returns staff records visible under STAFF_VIEW in the current organisation context, including user details, organisation membership details, SG statutory fields when present, and active per-employee pay item assignments. `staffPayItems` is populated only for users visible under PAYROLL_MANAGE; otherwise it is an empty array.

sectionIds.description: Active section memberships for the staff row

staffPayItems.description: Active pay item assignments for the staff row.

customRate.description: Custom rate override for this staff assignment

fixedAmount.description: Fixed amount override for this staff assignment

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile, organisation, access level, permissions, and workInfo for the organisation resolved from the workspace API token. Use this endpoint to bootstrap the caller's Workspace API session.

contractType.description: Employment contract type for the staff member

permissionGroups.description: Permission group references assigned to the staff member

sections.description: Section groups assigned to the staff member

teams.description: Teams assigned to the staff member

roles.description: Roles assigned to the staff member

get.description: Returns role definitions for the organisation associated with the workspace API token. This endpoint returns group metadata only and does not include staff assignments, staff rosters, shifts, or membership details. Query parameters are not supported.

Get section sales totals and period rows at half-hour or day granularity. Start and end select inclusive local dates; optional timeWindowStart and timeWindowEnd filter each day to a 30-minute-aligned local time window; sectionIds can narrow results within caller visibility.

granularity.description: Period resolution used for returned sales rows

timeWindow.description: Optional local time window applied to each date

targetSales.description: Sum of target sales for the range

actualSales.description: Sum of actual sales for the range

estimatedSalesPerLaborHour.description: Range-level estimated sales per scheduled labor hour; null for time-windowed queries

periodStart.description: Period start, as an ISO-8601 timestamp for halfHour granularity or YYYY-MM-DD for day granularity

periodEnd.description: Exclusive period end, as an ISO-8601 timestamp for halfHour granularity or YYYY-MM-DD for day granularity

targetSalesPerLaborHour.description: Target sales per labor hour for the period

get.description: Returns active section definitions for the organisation associated with the workspace API token. This endpoint returns group metadata only and does not include staff assignments, staff rosters, shifts, or membership details. Query parameters are not supported.

The response includes staff records in `data.items` for staff the caller can view with STAFF_VIEW, ordered by first name, last name, then org user ID. This endpoint accepts no query parameters and is not paginated.

orgUserId.description: Organisation-scoped staff row ID backed by OrgUserDetail.id

contractType.description: Employment contract type for the staff member

permissionGroups.description: Permission group references assigned to the staff member

sections.description: Section groups assigned to the staff member

teams.description: Teams assigned to the staff member

roles.description: Roles assigned to the staff member

staffTags.description: Staff tags assigned to the staff member

get.description: Returns team definitions for the organisation associated with the workspace API token. This endpoint returns group metadata only and does not include staff assignments, staff rosters, shifts, or membership details. Query parameters are not supported.

Returns staff-authored internal Wall posts in the token's organisation for export and reporting. Likes and comments are excluded by default and returned only when requested with `include=likes,comments`.

sectionId.description: Section where the Wall post appears, or null for organisation-wide posts

authorOrgUserId.description: Organisation-scoped staff row ID of the post author

likes.description: Present only when likes are requested

orgUserId.description: Organisation-scoped staff row ID of the liker

createdAt.description: Like creation timestamp in ISO-8601 format

comments.description: Present only when comments are requested

orgUserId.description: Organisation-scoped staff row ID of the commenter

createdAt.description: Comment creation timestamp in ISO-8601 format
Post creation timestamp in ISO-8601 format

updatedAt.description: Post update timestamp in ISO-8601 format

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's membership, organisation profile, and timeclock settings for the current organisation context.

403.description: User no longer has access to the current organisation context

get.summary: List organisations where the authenticated user has active membership
get.description: Returns membership records only. Organisation profile details are intentionally excluded from this endpoint.

Returns the staff record of a single staff member with the ID `staffId` when the staff member is visible to the caller with STAFF_VIEW. Missing staff and staff outside the caller's visibility both return staffNotFound.

orgUserId.description: Organisation-scoped staff row ID backed by OrgUserDetail.id

contractType.description: Employment contract type for the staff member

permissionGroups.description: Permission group references assigned to the staff member

sections.description: Section groups assigned to the staff member

teams.description: Teams assigned to the staff member

roles.description: Roles assigned to the staff member

staffTags.description: Staff tags assigned to the staff member

get.description: Returns a single Wall post with likes and comments. Discover wallPostId values from the Wall posts list endpoint.

sectionId.description: Section where the Wall post appears, or null for organisation-wide posts

authorOrgUserId.description: Organisation-scoped staff row ID of the post author

likes.description: Present only when likes are requested

orgUserId.description: Organisation-scoped staff row ID of the liker

createdAt.description: Like creation timestamp in ISO-8601 format

comments.description: Present only when comments are requested

orgUserId.description: Organisation-scoped staff row ID of the commenter

createdAt.description: Comment creation timestamp in ISO-8601 format
Post creation timestamp in ISO-8601 format

updatedAt.description: Post update timestamp in ISO-8601 format

post.summary: Retrieve compensation and career history collections
post.description: Required RBAC permission: PAYROLL_MANAGE. Returns time-effective compensation and career history collections for users visible under PAYROLL_MANAGE in the requested date range.

compensations.description: Compensation records effective in the requested range

workingDaysSetting.description: Working days setting (WEEKLY, MONTHLY, WEEKLY_PATTERN, CALENDAR)

workingDaysPatternPerWeek.description: Array of 7 values (0, 0.5, or 1) for each day of the week

isExcludedFromAttendance.description: Whether user is excluded from attendance

careerHistoryItems.description: Career history items effective in the requested range

effectiveDate.description: Date this career history item takes effect

post.description: Returns raw day-off rows for the requested date range. Supports optional user, section, and day-off-type filters and does not derive leave costs.

dayOffs.description: Raw day-off rows in the requested range

sectionId.description: Section ID on the day-off row

post.description: Required RBAC permission: PAYROLL_VIEW. Returns payruns, payroll rows, referenced pay items, business entities, and participant context as separate collections.

payruns.description: Payruns matching the requested selector and visible scope.

historicalPayItems.description: Pay items referenced by the payrun snapshot or live fallback.

historicalBusinessEntities.description: Business entities referenced by the payrun snapshot or live fallback.

participantContext.description: Participant context grouped under the payrun for downstream joins.

contextSource.description: Where participant context was resolved from

payrunParticipants.description: Filtered payrun participants for the returned payruns.

payrunItems.description: Payroll line items linked to the returned participants.

payItems.description: Live pay items for the organisation when requested.

businessEntities.description: Live business entities for the organisation when requested.

post.summary: Retrieve published shifts and assignment slots
post.description: Returns published-week shifts and shiftSlots in separate collections for the requested time range. Unassigned slots are included by default unless userIds is supplied or includeUnassigned is false.

shifts.description: Published shifts in the requested range

shiftSlots.description: Shift slots returned as a flat array where each slot contains a shiftId field

read.description: Timestamp when the assigned employee last acknowledged this shift slot in StaffAny; null when unread or reset after schedule changes

post.description: Returns published shift-based attendance data for the requested date range. Supports optional user and section filters and does not include shift slots.

shiftRecords.description: Shift record rows linked to the returned work hours. ShiftSlot is intentionally omitted.

sectionId.description: Section ID from the underlying published shift

clockAttempts.description: Raw clock-in and clock-out records referenced by the bundled shift records.

createdBy.description: User ID that created the clock record

workHours.description: Published shift-based work hour rows included in the response bundle.

startTime.description: Start timestamp used for range filtering

ShiftRecord.description: Embedded shift record data. ShiftSlot is intentionally omitted.

post.description: Requires the workspaceApiWritesEnabled organisation flag. Creates a raw day-off assignment using the same validations and clash behavior as the internal day-off assignment endpoint.

sectionId.description: Section ID on the day-off row

unassignedShiftSlots.description: Shift slots unassigned because of the day-off assignment

clashingShiftSlots.description: Shift slots still clashing after assignment

post.description: Requires the workspaceApiWritesEnabled organisation flag. Creates multiple shifts atomically. Each item derives or creates its target week from sectionId and timeStart, then creates unassigned shift slots from the requested role counts.

results.description: Created shifts in the same order as the request items

shiftSlotIds.description: Shift slot IDs created for the shift

post.description: Requires the workspaceApiWritesEnabled organisation flag. Atomically assigns existing unassigned shift slots, or assigns by shift and role by reusing an empty matching slot before creating a new assigned slot.

results.description: Assignment results in the same order as request items

post.description: Requires the workspaceApiWritesEnabled organisation flag. Atomically clears assigned shift slots and reuses existing internal unassignment restrictions and side effects.

results.description: Unassignment results in the same order as request items

post.summary: Assign leave to a staff member
post.description: Creates one assigned leave record for a staff member. Requires workspaceApiWritesEnabled and applies the same leave eligibility, balance, timesheet-lock, and shift-conflict checks as StaffAny.

staffId.description: StaffAny user ID for the staff member

leaveApplicationId.description: Linked leave application ID, or null for manual records

sectionId.description: Section ID where the leave hours are counted

type.description: How the leave record was created

unassignedShiftSlots.description: Shift slots unassigned by the leave operation

clashingShiftSlots.description: Shift slots clashing after the leave operation

post.description: Returns assigned leave records in the requested date range, with optional staff, section, and leave-type filters. Results are leave records only; balances, applications, and payroll calculations are not included.

staffId.description: StaffAny user ID for the staff member

leaveApplicationId.description: Linked leave application ID, or null for manual records

sectionId.description: Section ID where the leave hours are counted

type.description: How the leave record was created

from.description: Requested start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

to.description: Requested end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

delete.description: Requires the workspaceApiWritesEnabled organisation flag. Destroys a raw day-off assignment using the same restrictions and side effects as the internal day-off unassignment endpoint.

sectionId.description: Section ID on the day-off row

clashingShiftSlots.description: Shift slots that may now be assignable after unassignment

delete.description: Requires the workspaceApiWritesEnabled organisation flag. Deletes shifts and their child shift slots atomically using the same restrictions and side effects as internal shift deletion.

results.description: Deleted shift IDs in the same order as request shiftIds

delete.description: Deletes one assigned leave record. Requires workspaceApiWritesEnabled and does not reject or modify a leave application; application-linked records may be restricted.

staffId.description: StaffAny user ID for the staff member

leaveApplicationId.description: Linked leave application ID, or null for manual records

sectionId.description: Section ID where the leave hours are counted

type.description: How the leave record was created

unassignedShiftSlots.description: Shift slots unassigned by the leave operation

clashingShiftSlots.description: Shift slots clashing after the leave operation

patch.description: Requires the workspaceApiWritesEnabled organisation flag. Updates scheduling overrides and notes for a single shift slot using the same validations, restrictions, and side effects as the internal shift slot update endpoint.

read.description: Timestamp when the assigned employee last acknowledged this shift slot in StaffAny; null when unread or reset after schedule changes
